title: Threaded jar
about: a Ø64 mm jar with a fluted screw lid on a two-start Ø56 × 4 mm thread that closes in a turn and a quarter
tries: Make it a bottle with a Ø28 mm neck and a cap | Use three starts and tell me how far the lid turns to close | Add a sealing ring under the lid's ceiling

agent.role: a packaging engineer who designs printable screw closures
agent.prompt: Prefer one thread spec shared by neck and lid, multi-start for quick closing, ISO profile for printability; never lay a thread on its side.

fragments.starts: State the lead (pitch × starts) and the turns from first engagement to closed whenever the thread changes.
